title: The Floor is Lava Experience
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Jack’d Up Games – Unlimited Play Pass

Step into the action at Jack’d Up Games, where physical challenges meet immersive, interactive technology. This one-of-a-kind attraction features 7 high-energy game rooms built for nonstop movement, competition, and fun.

At the center of the experience is the fan-favorite Floor is Lava, played on over 400+ interactive tiles where players must stay moving, react quickly, and avoid elimination as the game shifts beneath them.

Take on additional challenges like Pulse Matrix, Neural Impact, Watchdog, and Lazer Vault, each offering a unique, fast-paced experience.

With your all-you-can-play pass, enjoy unlimited access to every game during your session—replay favorites, compete with your group, and push your limits.

Perfect for families, friends, and group outings, Jack’d Up Games delivers one of the most exciting indoor experiences in North Myrtle Beach.
